name: ROSE Bikes
description: German bicycle retailer selling road, gravel, mountain, urban and e-bikes, bike parts, clothing and accessories. Its shipping page has a Germany table among many delivery countries, and it lists its own stores in Germany.
description_es: Minorista alemán de bicicletas de ruta, gravel, montaña, urbanas y eléctricas, además de piezas, ropa y accesorios. Su página de envíos tiene una tabla para Alemania entre muchos países, y lista sus propias tiendas en Alemania.

ships_to.notes: A Germany shipping table is given on the shipping page. No island or border rules mentioned.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: The shipping page says store stock is for information only and products cannot be shipped from stores. Click and collect is not offered there.

search.notes: The search page loads, but results did not appear in the HTML; they probably render with JavaScript.

shopping_notes: Product pages in German. Country shops exist for several other countries.

sources.supports: product range, brands and store list
